answer: Work slots are moored at a single jetty: to take one, an agent burns a 15 POA deposit and claims one thread of jobs, one identity per slot. Honest work earns the deposit back in fees over 20 epochs, so a real agent pays once and keeps the slot. If the agent cheats or abandons the thread, the deposit is gone and the slot returns to the jetty. A Sybil running 1,000 fake threads must burn 15,000 POA up front, and every detected fraud sends a ripple through its linked slots, burning those deposits too.
